name: overthinker-ngegame
description: Overthinker-Ngegame — Windows Desktop AI Gaming Streamer (Monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,renderer,desktop -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @ngegame/backend" "npm run dev -w @ngegame/renderer" "npm run dev -w @ngegame/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ngegame/shared && npm run build -w @ngegame/backend && npm run build -w @ngegame/renderer && npm run build -w @ngegame/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ngegame/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ngegame/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ngegame/backend && npm run typecheck -w @ngegame/renderer && npm run typecheck -w @ngegame/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ngegame/shared && npm run test -w @ngegame/backend && npm run test -w @ngegame/renderer && npm run test:python
